mapper.select: SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, p.product_name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS requireQuantity FROM t_order_item oi JOIN t_order o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time < #{endTime} AND o.status NOT IN (1, 11, 12) AND oi.status = 1 AND oi.deleted_flag = 0 AND o.deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.sku_id, p.product_name
